spec.concept: Reentrancy: external calls can reenter before state is finalized, so update state before calling out
spec.scene: Dark navy background with a simple diagram of two contract boxes connected by a looping arrow in amber, showing a call going out and a callback returning before the balance is cleared
spec.overlay_text: State updates after untrusted calls allow repeated execution
spec.alt_text: Diagram of two contract boxes joined by a looping amber arrow on a navy background, showing a callback returning before the stored balance is cleared

spec.concept: Credibility through a track record of completed smart contract audits, with an invitation to request a review
spec.scene: Clean brand card on a deep navy background with a single amber accent line beneath the headline, minimal shield-and-grove motif in the corner, generous white space, calm and precise layout
spec.alt_text: Brand card with navy background and amber accent line reading: completed 12 smart contract audits

spec.concept: Unprotected Ether withdrawal: missing caller checks let anyone drain a contract
spec.scene: A simple vault outlined in amber on a deep navy background with a single open door and a keyhole, suggesting that only authorized callers should be able to move Ether out. Clean flat geometric style with generous space for the overlay text.
spec.alt_text: Navy card with an amber vault outline and keyhole above the text: Restrict withdrawals to authorized parties

spec.concept: A review that reports each finding clearly, with severity, root cause and a recommended fix
spec.scene: Clean brand card on a deep navy background with a single amber accent line beneath the headline text, minimal layout with generous spacing and no illustrations
spec.overlay_text: its severity, its root cause and a recommended fix
spec.alt_text: Navy card with white text reading its severity, its root cause and a recommended fix, underlined by an amber accent line

spec.concept: A single failed external call blocks an entire batch of payments, so each payout should be isolated and pulled by the recipient.
spec.scene: Technical diagram on a deep navy background: a row of recipient nodes connected by a line from a central contract node, with one node marked in amber to show the failed call blocking the rest. A separate simple pull-style path is sketched beside it with clean lines and generous spacing.
spec.overlay_text: one failing recipient can block the whole operation
spec.alt_text: Diagram of a contract sending payments to a row of recipients, with one highlighted failing recipient blocking the others, beside a simpler withdraw-style path.

spec.concept: A price oracle as a trust boundary: the contract trusts a price input that an attacker can move
spec.scene: Dark navy background with a simple diagram: a market price line on the left jumps sharply upward, passes through a gate labelled as a boundary in amber, and reaches a contract block on the right. Clean technical style, thin amber lines, white labels, calm and precise.
spec.overlay_text: An oracle is a trust boundary
spec.alt_text: Diagram of a price line spiking in a market, crossing an amber boundary gate and feeding a smart contract block, illustrating price oracle manipulation as a trust boundary.
